procedures.title: Brake main cylinder identification

specs.what: Corvette main cylinder, Delco Moraine, manual disc / power disc: code
Corvette main cylinder code DC: secondary piston identification
Corvette main cylinder, Delco Moraine, power disc: code
Corvette main cylinder code PG: secondary piston identification

notes: From figure 30 in the manual (Corvette rows only).
The two-letter code is stamped on top of the closed end of the cylinder barrel.

procedures.title: Dual main cylinder: parts replacement rules
steps: Replace a main cylinder only with one stamped with the same two-letter code, which marks its displacement.
Replace pistons only with ones carrying the same ring/groove marks on the shank and the same push-rod socket shape as the originals.
Note which outlets carry check valves (see next page).
notes: Each car line has its own main cylinder displacement, so the correct parts are essential for both whole cylinders and pistons.
1968 dual main cylinders come from Delco Moraine or Bendix. A Bendix unit has a secondary piston stop bolt on the bottom of the casting; Delco Moraine units do not (see figure 1 in the manual).
Secondary piston length is critical and is coded by rings or grooves on the shank. Primary pistons come with either a deep or a very shallow push-rod socket.
Delco Moraine cylinders for drum brakes have a rubber check valve and spring in each outlet boss.
